name: James Hyal

angles.text: James sailed west with Lady Jaina Proudmoore during the Third War, and his family ties the Eastern Kingdoms to Theramore Isle across the Great Sea.
James was known at home as a gifted cook. He went to Kalimdor to make a living running an inn and feeding travelers.

faq.answer: James Hyal is a human settler and gifted cook who crossed the Great Sea with Lady Jaina Proudmoore's expedition. After the fighting ended, he set out to make a living by opening an inn on Kalimdor.

James set out to open an inn somewhere on Kalimdor after arriving with Lady Proudmoore's expedition. His family has not heard from him recently, and Clerk Lendry in Theramore Isle keeps records that may give word of his whereabouts.
faq.q: Where can I find James Hyal?

faq.answer: Clerk Lendry handles local records in Theramore Isle. Travelers seeking settlers such as James Hyal can ask Lendry to check those records.

aliases: why did james go to kalimdor
faq.answer: James sailed with Lady Jaina Proudmoore's expedition during the Third War, among those leaving the Eastern Kingdoms. After the fighting ended, he chose to stay on Kalimdor and open an inn for travelers and settlers.
faq.q: Why did James travel to Kalimdor?

faq.answer: James's brother in the Eastern Kingdoms is looking for him after receiving no word for some time. He remembers James as a fine cook and thinks he may be busy establishing his inn.
faq.q: Who is looking for James Hyal?

faq.answer: James's brother thinks he may be occupied with his new business. His family has received no direct word from him for some time.
faq.q: Is James Hyal in any danger?

sections.body: During the Third War, many left their homes in the Eastern Kingdoms to follow Lady Jaina Proudmoore across the Great Sea. James Hyal went with them, known at home for his gift in the kitchen. After the fighting ended and Theramore Isle was founded, he sought a living on Kalimdor. He planned to open an inn for travelers and fellow settlers.
sections.title: Across the Great Sea

sections.body: Back in the Eastern Kingdoms, James's brother grows worried. No letters have come from across the sea, though he hopes James is busy running a roadside taproom. He asks travelers to seek his brother out. The search begins in Theramore, where Clerk Lendry keeps records of expedition members who have ventured into the wilderness.
sections.title: In Search of a Brother

summary: Across the Great Sea, James Hyal's family waits for word from Kalimdor. He sailed there with Lady Jaina Proudmoore's expedition and set out to open an inn on the frontier. Now his family looks to Theramore's records for news.
